verdict.rationale: Blink is a terminal app with SSH and Mosh. Its docs refer to Vim and Emacs users remapping keys (Caps as Esc, Cmd as Ctrl), which implies terminal editors run inside sessions, most likely on remote hosts. The local command list (cat, grep, ls, etc.) names no editor, and nothing mentions syntax or lint checkers; the VS Code integration is not a terminal-based editor. Missing for 10: an explicitly documented terminal editor bundled locally, any evidence of running syntax/lint checkers in the app, and hands-on corroboration of an editing workflow.
